verdict_notes: margin fell QoQ and is not up YoY

annual_report.business: J.G. Chemicals Limited manufactures zinc oxide and zinc sulphate through recycling chemistry, primarily serving the rubber and tyre industry which accounts for 85% of revenue.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Together, the two fronts expand the Company's installed capacity by more than half by 2029.
At full utilisation, the site has revenue potential of ₹9,000 mn, close to nine times the capital required to build it.

key_risks: Business concentration risk with 85% revenue from rubber and tyre sector
Geographic concentration risk with negligible supply to western India demand clusters
Execution risk on Dahej greenfield plant commissioning in Q3 FY27
Dependence on internal accruals for funding expansion with zero debt raised

latest_guidance.statement: Dahej Phase 1 utilization 50-60% in FY28, 70-80% in FY29; Phase 2 expansion to start in FY29
Consolidated EBITDA margin target 14-15% with higher value-added product share
Target to increase non-rubber revenue contribution from current 15% to 30% over next few years
Internal target to double revenue every 3 years; confident FY27 revenue will exceed INR1,200 crores vs FY24 ~INR600 crores
Target consolidated EBITDA margin of 14-15% in 3 years driven by value-added product share increase
